title: Roman to Integer
statement: Convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value. Normally symbols descend in value and you add them, but six subtractive pairs (IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM) mean subtract instead.
constraints: s is a valid Roman numeral in the range 1 to 3999
hints: Map each symbol to its value in a dictionary or switch.
Walk left to right. A symbol worth LESS than the one after it is being subtracted.
So add its value normally, but subtract it when the next symbol is larger. The final symbol is always added.
